label: ZKN_Y_001_000
text:
For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining
nourishment from the seed on its back.

label: ZKN_Y_002_000
text:
When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet
aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.

label: ZKN_Y_003_000
text:
After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells
stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_Y_004_000
text:
From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of
its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to
go out.

label: ZKN_Y_005_000
text:
When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air
temperature to unbearably high levels.

label: ZKN_Y_006_000
text:
Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an
altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very
high temperatures.

label: ZKN_Y_007_000
text:
Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws
into its shell when in danger.

label: ZKN_Y_008_000
text:
It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is
popular as a symbol of longevity.

label: ZKN_Y_009_000
text:
The pressurized water jets on this brutal Pokémon’s
shell are used for high-speed tackles.

label: ZKN_Y_010_000
text:
Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any
surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

label: ZKN_Y_011_000
text:
This Pokémon is vulnerable to attack while its shell
is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

label: ZKN_Y_012_000
text:
The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust.
As a result, this Pokémon can fly about even
in rain.

label: ZKN_Y_013_000
text:
Its poison stinger is very powerful.
Its bright-colored body is intended to
warn off its enemies.

label: ZKN_Y_014_000
text:
While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators
under leaves and in nooks of branches.

label: ZKN_Y_015_000
text:
May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds,
all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on
its rear.

label: ZKN_Y_016_000
text:
It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict.
If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

label: ZKN_Y_017_000
text:
Very protective of its sprawling territorial area,
this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

label: ZKN_Y_018_000
text:
It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate
enemies. It races through the skies at
Mach-2 speed.

label: ZKN_Y_019_000
text:
Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow
continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle
them down.

label: ZKN_Y_020_000
text:
The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers.
It searches wide areas for food.

label: ZKN_Y_021_000
text:
Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short
wings at high speed to stay airborne.

label: ZKN_Y_022_000
text:
It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings.
It fights by using its sharp beak.

label: ZKN_Y_023_000
text:
Moving silently and stealthily, it eats the eggs of
birds, such as Pidgey and Spearow, whole.

label: ZKN_Y_024_000
text:
To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and
makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth.

label: ZKN_Y_025_000
text:
It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks.
If threatened, it looses electric charges from
the sacs.

label: ZKN_Y_026_000
text:
It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity,
instantly downing foes several times its size.

label: ZKN_Y_027_000
text:
Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid
areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

label: ZKN_Y_028_000
text:
Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can
roll while curled up to attack or escape.

label: ZKN_Y_029_000
text:
Small and very docile, it protects itself with its
small, poisonous horn when attacked.

label: ZKN_Y_030_000
text:
When feeding its young, it first chews the food into
a paste, then spits it out for the offspring.

label: ZKN_Y_031_000
text:
The body is covered by stiff, needlelike scales.
If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

label: ZKN_Y_032_000
text:
Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is
listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs
when angered.

label: ZKN_Y_033_000
text:
An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack.
The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

label: ZKN_Y_034_000
text:
One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone
pole as if it were a matchstick.

label: ZKN_Y_035_000
text:
The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back
apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

label: ZKN_Y_036_000
text:
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run
and hide the moment it senses people.

label: ZKN_Y_037_000
text:
While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it
grows, several new tails are sprouted.

label: ZKN_Y_038_000
text:
Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its
many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

label: ZKN_Y_039_000
text:
If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer
and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

label: ZKN_Y_040_000
text:
The body is soft and rubbery. When angered,
it will suck in air and inflate itself to an
enormous size.

label: ZKN_Y_041_000
text:
It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic
cries for echolocation to flit about in darkness.

label: ZKN_Y_042_000
text:
Once it starts sucking blood, it does not stop until
it is full. It flies at night in search of prey.

label: ZKN_Y_043_000
text:
Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night,
it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.

label: ZKN_Y_044_000
text:
The honey it drools from its mouth smells so
atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

label: ZKN_Y_045_000
text:
It has the world’s largest petals. With every step,
the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

label: ZKN_Y_046_000
text:
Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots.
The mushrooms on its back absorb most of
the nutrition.

label: ZKN_Y_047_000
text:
The larger the mushroom on its back grows,
the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

label: ZKN_Y_048_000
text:
Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats
bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

label: ZKN_Y_049_000
text:
The wings are covered with dustlike scales.
Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly
toxic dust.

label: ZKN_Y_050_000
text:
Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light,
its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

label: ZKN_Y_051_000
text:
Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the
hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

label: ZKN_Y_052_000
text:
Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a
nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

label: ZKN_Y_053_000
text:
Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a
sound. It attacks in an instant.

label: ZKN_Y_054_000
text:
It has mystical powers but doesn’t recall that it has
used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

label: ZKN_Y_055_000
text:
The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an
adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly
in lakes, etc.

label: ZKN_Y_056_000
text:
It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes
enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

label: ZKN_Y_057_000
text:
It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase,
it will tenaciously track the target no matter
how far.

label: ZKN_Y_058_000
text:
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly
stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

label: ZKN_Y_059_000
text:
Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty.
Anyone hearing it can’t help but grovel before it.

label: ZKN_Y_060_000
text:
The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by
area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.

label: ZKN_Y_061_000
text:
Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can
live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

label: ZKN_Y_062_000
text:
A swimmer adept at both the front crawl and
breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best
human swimmers.

label: ZKN_Y_063_000
text:
It senses impending attacks and teleports away to
safety before the actual attacks can strike.

label: ZKN_Y_064_000
text:
If it uses its abilities, it emits special alpha waves
that cause machines to malfunction.

label: ZKN_Y_065_000
text:
Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its IQ
(intelligence quotient) is said to be around 5,000.

label: ZKN_Y_066_000
text:
Its whole body is composed of muscles.
Even though it’s the size of a human child,
it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

label: ZKN_Y_067_000
text:
It can lift a dump truck with one hand. Using that
power, it helps people with heavy jobs.

label: ZKN_Y_068_000
text:
It uses its four powerful arms to pin the limbs of its
foe, then throws the victim over the horizon.

label: ZKN_Y_069_000
text:
Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the
bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary
mandrake plant.

label: ZKN_Y_070_000
text:
It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy
and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

label: ZKN_Y_071_000
text:
Once ingested into this Pokémon’s body,
even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

label: ZKN_Y_072_000
text:
Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by
accident are often punished by their stingers.

label: ZKN_Y_073_000
text:
It has 80 tentacles that move about freely.
They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp,
stabbing pain.

label: ZKN_Y_074_000
text:
It is impossible to distinguish from rocks. It slams
against others in contests of hardness.

label: ZKN_Y_075_000
text:
Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any
obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

label: ZKN_Y_076_000
text:
Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulder-like
body. It sheds its hide just once a year.

label: ZKN_Y_077_000
text:
Its legs grow strong while it chases after its parent.
It runs in fields and mountains all day.

label: ZKN_Y_078_000
text:
It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing
ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

label: ZKN_Y_079_000
text:
It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its
tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.

label: ZKN_Y_080_000
text:
When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail
was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve
into Slowbro.

label: ZKN_Y_081_000
text:
It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges
Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.

label: ZKN_Y_082_000
text:
Generates strange radio signals. It raises the
temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within
3,300 feet.

label: ZKN_Y_083_000
text:
It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in
its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.

label: ZKN_Y_084_000
text:
The brains in its two heads appear to communicate
emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

label: ZKN_Y_085_000
text:
An odd species that is rarely found. The three
heads respectively represent joy, sadness,
and anger.

label: ZKN_Y_086_000
text:
Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and
tough. It is active in bitter cold of
-40 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_Y_087_000
text:
Its streamlined body has little drag in water.
The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.

label: ZKN_Y_088_000
text:
Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up
polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

label: ZKN_Y_089_000
text:
A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly
kills plants and trees on contact.

label: ZKN_Y_090_000
text:
Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable
parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

label: ZKN_Y_091_000
text:
Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered,
even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it
is attacking.

label: ZKN_Y_092_000
text:
Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by
its gaseous body, which contains poison.

label: ZKN_Y_093_000
text:
It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal the victim’s
life force. It lurks in darkness for prey.

label: ZKN_Y_094_000
text:
Hiding in people’s shadows at night, it absorbs their
heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

label: ZKN_Y_095_000
text:
It usually lives underground. It searches for food
while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles
per hour.

label: ZKN_Y_096_000
text:
If you think that you had a good dream but you
can’t remember it, a Drowzee has probably eaten it.

label: ZKN_Y_097_000
text:
Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in
three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

label: ZKN_Y_098_000
text:
It can be found near the sea. The large pincers
grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

label: ZKN_Y_099_000
text:
Its pincers grow peculiarly large. If it lifts the
pincers too fast, it loses its balance and staggers.

label: ZKN_Y_100_000
text:
Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a
Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

label: ZKN_Y_101_000
text:
It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy
inside its body. Even a small shock makes
it explode.

label: ZKN_Y_102_000
text:
Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort,
it was discovered to be a life-form more like
plant seeds.

label: ZKN_Y_103_000
text:
It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows
too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

label: ZKN_Y_104_000
text:
It always wears the skull of its dead mother, so no
one has any idea what its hidden face looks like.

label: ZKN_Y_105_000
text:
The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the
bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

label: ZKN_Y_106_000
text:
If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch
even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

label: ZKN_Y_107_000
text:
The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this Pokémon.
It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

label: ZKN_Y_108_000
text:
Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be
moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

label: ZKN_Y_109_000
text:
Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft.
The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

label: ZKN_Y_110_000
text:
Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two
small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as
a Weezing.

label: ZKN_Y_111_000
text:
It is inept at turning because of its four short legs.
It can only charge and run in one direction.

label: ZKN_Y_112_000
text:
It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution.
It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

label: ZKN_Y_113_000
text:
It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently
rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

label: ZKN_Y_114_000
text:
It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their
subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

label: ZKN_Y_115_000
text:
If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch
to play. The adult keeps a close eye on
the youngster.

label: ZKN_Y_116_000
text:
It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses
danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

label: ZKN_Y_117_000
text:
It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly
flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

label: ZKN_Y_118_000
text:
Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in
water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

label: ZKN_Y_119_000
text:
It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in
streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with
its life.

label: ZKN_Y_120_000
text:
It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night,
its central core flashes with a red light.

label: ZKN_Y_121_000
text:
At the center of its body is a red core, which sends
mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

label: ZKN_Y_122_000
text:
It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able
to create walls out of thin air by miming.

label: ZKN_Y_123_000
text:
It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes,
moving too fast for the human eye to track.

label: ZKN_Y_124_000
text:
It speaks using a language that sounds human.
Research is under way to determine what is
being said.

label: ZKN_Y_125_000
text:
It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally
appears around large power plants and so on.

label: ZKN_Y_126_000
text:
Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered
by flames that shimmer like the sun.

label: ZKN_Y_127_000
text:
It swings its long pincer horns wildly to attack.
During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

label: ZKN_Y_128_000
text:
When it is about to tackle, it whips its body
repeatedly with its three long tails.

label: ZKN_Y_129_000
text:
In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than
the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

label: ZKN_Y_130_000
text:
Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is
capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

label: ZKN_Y_131_000
text:
Its high intelligence enables it to understand human
speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

label: ZKN_Y_132_000
text:
It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to
transform into other life-forms.

label: ZKN_Y_133_000
text:
Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this
special Pokémon conceals many different
possible evolutions.

label: ZKN_Y_134_000
text:
It has evolved to be suitable for an aquatic life.
It can invisibly melt away into water.

label: ZKN_Y_135_000
text:
It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to
blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

label: ZKN_Y_136_000
text:
It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling
deeply, it blows out flames of nearly
3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_Y_137_000
text:
A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming
code. It is capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

label: ZKN_Y_138_000
text:
Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses
air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

label: ZKN_Y_139_000
text:
Once wrapped around its prey, it never lets go.
It eats the prey by tearing at it with sharp fangs.

label: ZKN_Y_140_000
text:
This Pokémon was regenerated from the fossil of an
ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

label: ZKN_Y_141_000
text:
A slim and fast swimmer. It slices its prey with its
sharp sickles and drinks the body fluids.

label: ZKN_Y_142_000
text:
This vicious Pokémon is said to have flown in
ancient skies while shrieking high-pitched cries.

label: ZKN_Y_143_000
text:
Its stomach can digest any kind of food,
even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

label: ZKN_Y_144_000
text:
A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to
doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

label: ZKN_Y_145_000
text:
A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in
thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

label: ZKN_Y_146_000
text:
One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that
its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

label: ZKN_Y_147_000
text:
This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually
sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

label: ZKN_Y_148_000
text:
A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura.
It is said to have the ability to change the weather.

label: ZKN_Y_149_000
text:
It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea.
It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

label: ZKN_Y_150_000
text:
A Pokémon created by recombining Mew’s genes.
It’s said to have the most savage heart
among Pokémon.

label: ZKN_Y_151_000
text:
Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all
Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

label: ZKN_Y_152_000
text:
It uses the leaf on its head to determine the
temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

label: ZKN_Y_153_000
text:
The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma
that perks people up.

label: ZKN_Y_154_000
text:
Meganium’s breath has the power to revive dead
grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

label: ZKN_Y_155_000
text:
It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on
its back burn more vigorously.

label: ZKN_Y_156_000
text:
Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means
that it will attack with the fire on its back.

label: ZKN_Y_157_000
text:
It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing
fur together to cause huge explosions.

label: ZKN_Y_158_000
text:
Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of
crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

label: ZKN_Y_159_000
text:
Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its
fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

label: ZKN_Y_160_000
text:
When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws,
it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

label: ZKN_Y_161_000
text:
It stands on its tail so it can see a long way.
If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

label: ZKN_Y_162_000
text:
It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body.
The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

label: ZKN_Y_163_000
text:
It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so
fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

label: ZKN_Y_164_000
text:
When it needs to think, it rotates its head
180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

label: ZKN_Y_165_000
text:
It is timid and clusters together with others.
The fluid secreted by its feet indicates its location.

label: ZKN_Y_166_000
text:
The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller
depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

label: ZKN_Y_167_000
text:
It lies still in the same pose for days in its web,
waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

label: ZKN_Y_168_000
text:
It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later,
it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

label: ZKN_Y_169_000
text:
Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and
quietly so it can sneak up on prey without
its noticing.

label: ZKN_Y_170_000
text:
It shoots positive and negative electricity between
the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

label: ZKN_Y_171_000
text:
It blinds prey with an intense burst of light.
With the prey incapacitated, the Pokémon
swallows it in a single gulp.

label: ZKN_Y_172_000
text:
It is not yet skilled at storing electricity.
It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

label: ZKN_Y_173_000
text:
Many appear when the night skies are filled with
shooting stars. They disappear with sunrise.

label: ZKN_Y_174_000
text:
It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will
bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

label: ZKN_Y_175_000
text:
A proverb claims that happiness will come to
anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

label: ZKN_Y_176_000
text:
They say that it will appear before kindhearted,
caring people and shower them with happiness.

label: ZKN_Y_177_000
text:
It usually forages for food on the ground but may,
on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck
at shoots.

label: ZKN_Y_178_000
text:
They say that it stays still and quiet because it is
seeing both the past and future at the same time.

label: ZKN_Y_179_000
text:
It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay
cool in summer and warm in winter.

label: ZKN_Y_180_000
text:
If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity,
its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

label: ZKN_Y_181_000
text:
The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from
far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

label: ZKN_Y_182_000
text:
When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn
out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

label: ZKN_Y_183_000
text:
The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than
water, so it acts as a float.

label: ZKN_Y_184_000
text:
The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it
camouflage itself when it’s in the water.

label: ZKN_Y_185_000
text:
It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates
water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

label: ZKN_Y_186_000
text:
If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing cry, they
respond by gathering from far and wide.

label: ZKN_Y_187_000
text:
It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather
in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

label: ZKN_Y_188_000
text:
It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats
in the air to get closer to the sun.

label: ZKN_Y_189_000
text:
Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to
make its way to any place in the world it wants.

label: ZKN_Y_190_000
text:
Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a
tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

label: ZKN_Y_191_000
text:
It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the
leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

label: ZKN_Y_192_000
text:
It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for
its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

label: ZKN_Y_193_000
text:
If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock
waves that will shatter windows in the area.

label: ZKN_Y_194_000
text:
When the temperature cools in the evening,
they emerge from water to seek food along
the shore.

label: ZKN_Y_195_000
text:
This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature.
While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

label: ZKN_Y_196_000
text:
Its fur is so sensitive, it can feel minute shifts in the
air and predict the weather...and its foes’ thoughts.

label: ZKN_Y_197_000
text:
When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its
body glow faintly and it’s filled with a
mysterious power.

label: ZKN_Y_198_000
text:
Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring
misfortune to all those who see it at night.

label: ZKN_Y_199_000
text:
When its head was bitten, toxins entered
Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an
extraordinary power.

label: ZKN_Y_200_000
text:
It likes playing mischievous tricks, such as
screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

label: ZKN_Y_201_000
text:
Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery
whether language or Unown came first.

label: ZKN_Y_202_000
text:
To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in
the darkness. It is never first to attack.

label: ZKN_Y_203_000
text:
Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you
get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

label: ZKN_Y_204_000
text:
It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it
from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

label: ZKN_Y_205_000
text:
It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters
pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

label: ZKN_Y_206_000
text:
It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a
mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

label: ZKN_Y_207_000
text:
It flies straight at its target’s face, then clamps
down on the startled victim to inject poison.

label: ZKN_Y_208_000
text:
It chews its way through boulders with its
sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the
darkness underground.

label: ZKN_Y_209_000
text:
Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is,
however, considered by women to be cute.

label: ZKN_Y_210_000
text:
It can make most any Pokémon run away simply by
opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.

label: ZKN_Y_211_000
text:
The small spikes covering its body developed from
scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

label: ZKN_Y_212_000
text:
It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by
upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

label: ZKN_Y_213_000
text:
It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks,
it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

label: ZKN_Y_214_000
text:
With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw
around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

label: ZKN_Y_215_000
text:
Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked,
it suddenly extends the claws and startles
its enemy.

label: ZKN_Y_216_000
text:
Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit
is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

label: ZKN_Y_217_000
text:
Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at
climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

label: ZKN_Y_218_000
text:
Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep
moving, its body will cool and harden.

label: ZKN_Y_219_000
text:
Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing.
Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

label: ZKN_Y_220_000
text:
If it smells something enticing, it dashes off
headlong to find the source of the aroma.

label: ZKN_Y_221_000
text:
Because the long hair all over its body obscures its
sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

label: ZKN_Y_222_000
text:
They prefer unpolluted southern seas. Their coral
branches lose their color and deteriorate in
dirty water.

label: ZKN_Y_223_000
text:
Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a
Mantine’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.

label: ZKN_Y_224_000
text:
It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles,
then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

label: ZKN_Y_225_000
text:
It carries food all day long. When someone is lost
in the mountains, it shares that food.

label: ZKN_Y_226_000
text:
While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores
Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

label: ZKN_Y_227_000
text:
Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor,
it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

label: ZKN_Y_228_000
text:
To corner prey, they check each other’s location
using barks that only they can understand.

label: ZKN_Y_229_000
text:
The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins.
If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

label: ZKN_Y_230_000
text:
It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths
at which no other life-forms can survive.

label: ZKN_Y_231_000
text:
It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily
pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

label: ZKN_Y_232_000
text:
The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank
in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

label: ZKN_Y_233_000
text:
With planetary development software installed,
it became capable of working in space.

label: ZKN_Y_234_000
text:
The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to
create a strange space where reality is distorted.

label: ZKN_Y_235_000
text:
Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let
its comrades plant footprints on its back.

label: ZKN_Y_236_000
text:
To brush up on its fighting skills, it will challenge
anyone. It has a very strong competitive spirit.

label: ZKN_Y_237_000
text:
If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like
kicks, you may get a closer experience with one
than you’d like.

label: ZKN_Y_238_000
text:
It tests everything by touching with its lips,
which remember what it likes and dislikes.

label: ZKN_Y_239_000
text:
Spinning its arms around to generate electricity
makes the area between its horns shine light blue.

label: ZKN_Y_240_000
text:
Its magma-like blood circulates throughout
its body. Its body’s heat can top
1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_Y_241_000
text:
Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the
ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

label: ZKN_Y_242_000
text:
This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to
health. It senses feelings of sadness.

label: ZKN_Y_243_000
text:
This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body,
then sweeps across the land, shooting
off electricity.

label: ZKN_Y_244_000
text:
It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts
somewhere around the globe.

label: ZKN_Y_245_000
text:
Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can
instantly purify filthy, murky water.

label: ZKN_Y_246_000
text:
Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and
becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the
surrounding soil.

label: ZKN_Y_247_000
text:
Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very
strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

label: ZKN_Y_248_000
text:
If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries
rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

label: ZKN_Y_249_000
text:
It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is
rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

label: ZKN_Y_250_000
text:
It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by
shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

label: ZKN_Y_251_000
text:
It has the power to travel across time, but it is said
to appear only in peaceful times.

label: ZKN_Y_252_000
text:
Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on
walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang
from above.

label: ZKN_Y_253_000
text:
It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its
prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

label: ZKN_Y_254_000
text:
It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp
leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

label: ZKN_Y_255_000
text:
A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug.
It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_Y_256_000
text:
During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases.
Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

label: ZKN_Y_257_000
text:
When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from
its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear
over buildings.

label: ZKN_Y_258_000
text:
To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of
water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

label: ZKN_Y_259_000
text:
Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing
has made its legs sturdy.

label: ZKN_Y_260_000
text:
It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes
down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

label: ZKN_Y_261_000
text:
It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of
smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever
losing track.

label: ZKN_Y_262_000
text:
It chases down prey in a pack of around ten.
They defeat foes with perfectly
coordinated teamwork.

label: ZKN_Y_263_000
text:
A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an
interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

label: ZKN_Y_264_000
text:
It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However,
because it can only run straight, it often fails.

label: ZKN_Y_265_000
text:
It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels
attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

label: ZKN_Y_266_000
text:
It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for
evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

label: ZKN_Y_267_000
text:
It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its
long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.

label: ZKN_Y_268_000
text:
It never forgets any attack it endured while in the
cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

label: ZKN_Y_269_000
text:
It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust
when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

label: ZKN_Y_270_000
text:
It searches about for clean water. If it does not
drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

label: ZKN_Y_271_000
text:
It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler,
it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

label: ZKN_Y_272_000
text:
The rhythm of bright, festive music activates
Ludicolo’s cells, making it more powerful.

label: ZKN_Y_273_000
text:
When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just
like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_Y_274_000
text:
It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head,
it makes a flute whose song makes
listeners uneasy.

label: ZKN_Y_275_000
text:
By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of
100 feet per second that can level houses.

label: ZKN_Y_276_000
text:
It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other
lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles
a day.

label: ZKN_Y_277_000
text:
It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its
prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

label: ZKN_Y_278_000
text:
It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs.
Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.

label: ZKN_Y_279_000
text:
It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small
Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

label: ZKN_Y_280_000
text:
It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and
Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

label: ZKN_Y_281_000
text:
It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the
space around it and see into the future.

label: ZKN_Y_282_000
text:
It has the power to predict the future. Its power
peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

label: ZKN_Y_283_000
text:
It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey
with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

label: ZKN_Y_284_000
text:
It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any
direction--to and fro and sideways.

label: ZKN_Y_285_000
text:
It spouts poison spores from the top of its head.
These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

label: ZKN_Y_286_000
text:
It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful
punches while its foe is hampered by
inhaled spores.

label: ZKN_Y_287_000
text:
If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied.
Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

label: ZKN_Y_288_000
text:
Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving
constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

label: ZKN_Y_289_000
text:
It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon. However,
it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up
energy all at once.

label: ZKN_Y_290_000
text:
It can sometimes live underground for more than
10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots
of trees.

label: ZKN_Y_291_000
text:
Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes
unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

label: ZKN_Y_292_000
text:
A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in
a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

label: ZKN_Y_293_000
text:
If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out
with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

label: ZKN_Y_294_000
text:
The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks.
It stamps its feet to power up.

label: ZKN_Y_295_000
text:
Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a
tremor--or like an earthquake has struck.

label: ZKN_Y_296_000
text:
It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a
gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

label: ZKN_Y_297_000
text:
It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon.
It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

label: ZKN_Y_298_000
text:
It swings its large, nutrient-filled tail around to fight
opponents bigger than itself.

label: ZKN_Y_299_000
text:
Its magnetic nose consistently faces north.
Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.

label: ZKN_Y_300_000
text:
It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail
until it gets dizzy.

label: ZKN_Y_301_000
text:
It is highly popular among female Trainers for its
sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

label: ZKN_Y_302_000
text:
It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp
claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

label: ZKN_Y_303_000
text:
Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed
by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

label: ZKN_Y_304_000
text:
When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that
covered its whole body and develops a new one.

label: ZKN_Y_305_000
text:
It habitually shows off its strength with the size of
sparks it creates by ramming its steel body
into boulders.

label: ZKN_Y_306_000
text:
While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by
breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

label: ZKN_Y_307_000
text:
It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger,
its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

label: ZKN_Y_308_000
text:
Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power
to predict its foe’s next move.

label: ZKN_Y_309_000
text:
It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging.
It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

label: ZKN_Y_310_000
text:
It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a
thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

label: ZKN_Y_311_000
text:
It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts
out its body to create crackling noises.

label: ZKN_Y_312_000
text:
It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing,
its body lets off more and more sparks.

label: ZKN_Y_313_000
text:
It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights
up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

label: ZKN_Y_314_000
text:
With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw
signs with light in the night sky.

label: ZKN_Y_315_000
text:
Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are
said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

label: ZKN_Y_316_000
text:
There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is
digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

label: ZKN_Y_317_000
text:
It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special
enzymes can dissolve anything.

label: ZKN_Y_318_000
text:
It lives in massive rivers that course through
jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.

label: ZKN_Y_319_000
text:
It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting
seawater through its body. It is the bandit of
the sea.

label: ZKN_Y_320_000
text:
It eats one ton of food every day. It plays by
shooting stored seawater out its blowholes with
great force.

label: ZKN_Y_321_000
text:
The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth
of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

label: ZKN_Y_322_000
text:
The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees
Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses
Fire-type moves.

label: ZKN_Y_323_000
text:
If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower
of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

label: ZKN_Y_324_000
text:
It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out
black soot if it is endangered.

label: ZKN_Y_325_000
text:
It bounces around on its tail to keep its
heart pumping. It carries a pearl from
Clamperl on its head.

label: ZKN_Y_326_000
text:
It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power.
It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

label: ZKN_Y_327_000
text:
The chances of two Spinda having identical spot
patterns is less than one in four billion.

label: ZKN_Y_328_000
text:
It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait
at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

label: ZKN_Y_329_000
text:
It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping
its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the
prey with acid.

label: ZKN_Y_330_000
text:
Known as “The Desert Spirit,” this Pokémon hides in
the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

label: ZKN_Y_331_000
text:
It prefers harsh environments such as deserts.
It can survive for 30 days on water stored in
its body.

label: ZKN_Y_332_000
text:
Packs of them follow travelers through the desert
until the travelers can no longer move.

label: ZKN_Y_333_000
text:
It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes
a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

label: ZKN_Y_334_000
text:
On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and
blends into the clouds. It sings in a
beautiful soprano.

label: ZKN_Y_335_000
text:
Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper
nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

label: ZKN_Y_336_000
text:
Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on
its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.

label: ZKN_Y_337_000
text:
It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike
40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

label: ZKN_Y_338_000
text:
It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always
expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

label: ZKN_Y_339_000
text:
Its whiskers make a superb radar. They are used to
locate prey, even in the murkiest of water.

label: ZKN_Y_340_000
text:
It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps.
It will eat anything--if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

label: ZKN_Y_341_000
text:
Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any
environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

label: ZKN_Y_342_000
text:
Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon
that enter its territory with its pincers and throws
them out.

label: ZKN_Y_343_000
text:
It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare
Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

label: ZKN_Y_344_000
text:
It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by
an ancient civilization.

label: ZKN_Y_345_000
text:
It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and
was reanimated scientifically.

label: ZKN_Y_346_000
text:
It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then
melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.

label: ZKN_Y_347_000
text:
A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a
fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

label: ZKN_Y_348_000
text:
Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy.
It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

label: ZKN_Y_349_000
text:
It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms in
schools and lives at the bottom of rivers.

label: ZKN_Y_350_000
text:
It is the world’s most beautiful Pokémon. There are
many works of art featuring Milotic.

label: ZKN_Y_351_000
text:
It has the ability to change its form into the sun,
the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on
the weather.

label: ZKN_Y_352_000
text:
It changes its shading to match its surroundings
so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns
stay fixed.

label: ZKN_Y_353_000
text:
It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under
the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

label: ZKN_Y_354_000
text:
Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a
Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed
energy escapes.

label: ZKN_Y_355_000
text:
If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their
parents, it will spirit them away--or so it’s said.

label: ZKN_Y_356_000
text:
Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look
into its body are sucked into the void.

label: ZKN_Y_357_000
text:
The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a
year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored
tropical snack.

label: ZKN_Y_358_000
text:
Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel
great distances.

label: ZKN_Y_359_000
text:
It appears when it senses an impending natural
disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a
doom bringer.

label: ZKN_Y_360_000
text:
It grows strong by pushing up against others en
masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

label: ZKN_Y_361_000
text:
In the snow country, certain folklore says a house
will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

label: ZKN_Y_362_000
text:
It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
It uses this power to freeze its foes.

label: ZKN_Y_363_000
text:
Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it
from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

label: ZKN_Y_364_000
text:
Be it Spheal or Poké Ball, it will spin any round
object on its nose with the greatest of ease.

label: ZKN_Y_365_000
text:
It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick
layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

label: ZKN_Y_366_000
text:
It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime,
it makes a magnificent pearl.

label: ZKN_Y_367_000
text:
It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a
small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

label: ZKN_Y_368_000
text:
Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant.
With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed
that grows between rocks.

label: ZKN_Y_369_000
text:
A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea
exploration. It has not changed in over
100 million years.

label: ZKN_Y_370_000
text:
During the spawning season, countless Luvdisc
congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

label: ZKN_Y_371_000
text:
Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping
off cliffs every day.

label: ZKN_Y_372_000
text:
Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off.
The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy
and somewhat sluggish.

label: ZKN_Y_373_000
text:
It’s uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around
spouting flames and scorching fields
and mountains.

label: ZKN_Y_374_000
text:
It converses with others by using magnetic pulses.
In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

label: ZKN_Y_375_000
text:
It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two
brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

label: ZKN_Y_376_000
text:
Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has
the intelligence of a supercomputer.

label: ZKN_Y_377_000
text:
The same rocks that form its body have been found
in ground layers around the world.

label: ZKN_Y_378_000
text:
Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls
frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_Y_379_000
text:
Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal.
A study has revealed that its body is hollow.

label: ZKN_Y_380_000
text:
It can telepathically communicate with people. It
changes its appearance using its down that
refracts light.

label: ZKN_Y_381_000
text:
It understands human speech and is highly
intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that
dislikes fighting.

label: ZKN_Y_382_000
text:
It is said to have widened the seas by causing
downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

label: ZKN_Y_383_000
text:
This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the
land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

label: ZKN_Y_384_000
text:
It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky.
Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

label: ZKN_Y_385_000
text:
It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for
just one week every thousand years.

label: ZKN_Y_386_000
text:
DNA from a space virus mutated and became a
Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

label: ZKN_Y_387_000
text:
It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making
oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

label: ZKN_Y_388_000
text:
It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow
Pokémon there on its back.

label: ZKN_Y_389_000
text:
Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving
back to begin building their nests.

label: ZKN_Y_390_000
text:
The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end.
The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

label: ZKN_Y_391_000
text:
It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks.
Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

label: ZKN_Y_392_000
text:
It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all
its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

label: ZKN_Y_393_000
text:
Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food
from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

label: ZKN_Y_394_000
text:
It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows
that can snap even the thickest of trees.

label: ZKN_Y_395_000
text:
The three horns that extend from its beak attest to
its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

label: ZKN_Y_396_000
text:
They flock around mountains and fields, chasing
after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy
and annoying.

label: ZKN_Y_397_000
text:
It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over
territory occur when flocks collide.

label: ZKN_Y_398_000
text:
When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the
flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

label: ZKN_Y_399_000
text:
It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle
down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

label: ZKN_Y_400_000
text:
It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and
mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

label: ZKN_Y_401_000
text:
When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the
music of a xylophone.

label: ZKN_Y_402_000
text:
It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists
are studying these melodic patterns.

label: ZKN_Y_403_000
text:
All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees
while the foe is momentarily blinded.

label: ZKN_Y_404_000
text:
Strong electricity courses through the tips of its
sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

label: ZKN_Y_405_000
text:
Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in
handy when it’s scouting for danger.

label: ZKN_Y_406_000
text:
Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the
cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

label: ZKN_Y_407_000
text:
With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with
whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

label: ZKN_Y_408_000
text:
A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years
ago, it would snap obstructing trees with headbutts.

label: ZKN_Y_409_000
text:
Its skull is as hard as iron. It is a brute that tears
down jungle trees while catching prey.

label: ZKN_Y_410_000
text:
It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of
clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a
sturdy face.

label: ZKN_Y_411_000
text:
Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile
Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

label: ZKN_Y_412_000
text:
If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes
the cloak with materials nearby.

label: ZKN_Y_413_000
text:
When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of
this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

label: ZKN_Y_414_000
text:
It flutters around at night and steals honey from
the Combee hive.

label: ZKN_Y_415_000
text:
It collects and delivers honey to its colony.
At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

label: ZKN_Y_416_000
text:
Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its
grubs on honey collected by Combee.

label: ZKN_Y_417_000
text:
A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches
together in an effort to share stored electricity.

label: ZKN_Y_418_000
text:
It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and
pokes its head out of the water to see what is
going on.

label: ZKN_Y_419_000
text:
Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing
aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

label: ZKN_Y_420_000
text:
It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small
ball where it had been storing nutrients.

label: ZKN_Y_421_000
text:
If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded
petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.

label: ZKN_Y_422_000
text:
Its shape and coloration vary, depending on
its habitat.

label: ZKN_Y_423_000
text:
It apparently had a huge shell for protection in
ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.

label: ZKN_Y_424_000
text:
To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails.
It rarely uses its arms now.

label: ZKN_Y_425_000
text:
These Pokémon are called the “Signpost for
Wandering Spirits.” Children holding them
sometimes vanish.

label: ZKN_Y_426_000
text:
It’s drowsy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in
big groups. No one knows where they go.

label: ZKN_Y_427_000
text:
When it senses danger, it perks up its ears.
On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into
its fur.

label: ZKN_Y_428_000
text:
The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched
roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

label: ZKN_Y_429_000
text:
Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe.
It appears where you least expect it.

label: ZKN_Y_430_000
text:
Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with
numerous Murkrow in tow.

label: ZKN_Y_431_000
text:
When it’s happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful
movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

label: ZKN_Y_432_000
text:
To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly
cinches its waist with its twin tails.

label: ZKN_Y_433_000
text:
There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops,
the orb bounces all over and makes a
ringing sound.

label: ZKN_Y_434_000
text:
It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its
rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

label: ZKN_Y_435_000
text:
It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells
worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

label: ZKN_Y_436_000
text:
Implements shaped like it were discovered in
ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

label: ZKN_Y_437_000
text:
Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong
for rain was the way to make crops grow.

label: ZKN_Y_438_000
text:
It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that
looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.

label: ZKN_Y_439_000
text:
It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe
cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_Y_440_000
text:
It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks
is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.

label: ZKN_Y_441_000
text:
It can learn and speak human words. If they gather,
they all learn the same saying.

label: ZKN_Y_442_000
text:
It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as
punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

label: ZKN_Y_443_000
text:
It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls.
It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

label: ZKN_Y_444_000
text:
As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up
gems that it then hoards in its nest.

label: ZKN_Y_445_000
text:
It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane.
It never allows its prey to escape.

label: ZKN_Y_446_000
text:
It conceals food under the long fur on its body.
It carts around this food stash and swallows it
without chewing.

label: ZKN_Y_447_000
text:
The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to
alert others if it is afraid or sad.

label: ZKN_Y_448_000
text:
By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how
others are feeling from over half a mile away.

label: ZKN_Y_449_000
text:
It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from
germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

label: ZKN_Y_450_000
text:
It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its
body to create a towering twister for attack.

label: ZKN_Y_451_000
text:
It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey.
Its tail claws can inject its prey with a
savage poison.

label: ZKN_Y_452_000
text:
It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap
of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

label: ZKN_Y_453_000
text:
Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd
sound and hits flinching opponents with a
poison jab.

label: ZKN_Y_454_000
text:
Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a
scratch could prove fatal.

label: ZKN_Y_455_000
text:
It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey
with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

label: ZKN_Y_456_000
text:
After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its
tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

label: ZKN_Y_457_000
text:
To avoid detection by predators, it crawls along the
seafloor using the two fins on its chest.

label: ZKN_Y_458_000
text:
When it swims close to the surface of the ocean,
people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern
on its back.

label: ZKN_Y_459_000
text:
In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of
frozen treats around its belly.

label: ZKN_Y_460_000
text:
It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually
covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping
up blizzards.

label: ZKN_Y_461_000
text:
They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or
five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

label: ZKN_Y_462_000
text:
It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic
field. Three units generate magnetism.

label: ZKN_Y_463_000
text:
Their saliva contains lots of components that can
dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their
lick does not dissipate.

label: ZKN_Y_464_000
text:
It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its
muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at
rare times.

label: ZKN_Y_465_000
text:
Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm
season, you can’t even see its eyes.

label: ZKN_Y_466_000
text:
It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe,
then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

label: ZKN_Y_467_000
text:
It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit
out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

label: ZKN_Y_468_000
text:
It shares many blessings with people who respect
one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.

label: ZKN_Y_469_000
text:
This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of
transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail
help it stay balanced.

label: ZKN_Y_470_000
text:
Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result,
it is always enveloped in clear air.

label: ZKN_Y_471_000
text:
It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs
then become like needles it can fire.

label: ZKN_Y_472_000
text:
Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to
carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do
the rest.

label: ZKN_Y_473_000
text:
Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population
thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

label: ZKN_Y_474_000
text:
Its programming was modified to enable it to travel
through alien dimensions. Seems there might have
been an error...

label: ZKN_Y_475_000
text:
A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights
using extending swords on its elbows.

label: ZKN_Y_476_000
text:
It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses
using magnetic force.

label: ZKN_Y_477_000
text:
The antenna on its head captures radio waves from
the world of spirits that command it to take
people there.

label: ZKN_Y_478_000
text:
Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who
was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as Froslass.

label: ZKN_Y_479_000
text:
Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to
infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

label: ZKN_Y_480_000
text:
It is said that its emergence gave humans the
intelligence to improve their quality of life.

label: ZKN_Y_481_000
text:
It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to
leave its body to fly on the lake’s surface.

label: ZKN_Y_482_000
text:
It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came
from the same egg.

label: ZKN_Y_483_000
text:
It has the power to control time. It appears in
Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

label: ZKN_Y_484_000
text:
It has the ability to distort space. It is described as
a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

label: ZKN_Y_485_000
text:
Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its
body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

label: ZKN_Y_486_000
text:
There is an enduring legend that states this
Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

label: ZKN_Y_487_000
text:
It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed
upon the old world from the Distortion World.

label: ZKN_Y_488_000
text:
Those who sleep holding Cresselia’s feather are
assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent
the crescent moon.

label: ZKN_Y_489_000
text:
It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it
was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

label: ZKN_Y_490_000
text:
It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits
it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

label: ZKN_Y_491_000
text:
It can lull people to sleep and make them dream.
It is active during nights of the new moon.

label: ZKN_Y_492_000
text:
The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the
power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are
the message it delivers.

label: ZKN_Y_493_000
text:
It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born
before the universe even existed.

label: ZKN_Y_494_000
text:
When it shares the infinite energy it creates,
that being’s entire body will be overflowing
with power.

label: ZKN_Y_495_000
text:
They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in
sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their
tails droop.

label: ZKN_Y_496_000
text:
When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in
photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

label: ZKN_Y_497_000
text:
It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a
glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts
it internally.

label: ZKN_Y_498_000
text:
It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it
gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

label: ZKN_Y_499_000
text:
When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow
sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

label: ZKN_Y_500_000
text:
It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves.
It grows a beard of fire.

label: ZKN_Y_501_000
text:
It fights using the scalchop on its stomach.
In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately
by slashing.

label: ZKN_Y_502_000
text:
As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns
different forms for using the scalchops.

label: ZKN_Y_503_000
text:
One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor
can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of
them quiets everybody.

label: ZKN_Y_504_000
text:
Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on
the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming
from behind.

label: ZKN_Y_505_000
text:
When they see an enemy, their tails stand high,
and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their
cheek pouches.

label: ZKN_Y_506_000
text:
Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s also smart
enough to check its foe’s strength and avoid battle.

label: ZKN_Y_507_000
text:
It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and
decreases the amount of damage it receives.

label: ZKN_Y_508_000
text:
Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable
that a person would be fine even overnight on a
wintry mountain.

label: ZKN_Y_509_000
text:
They steal from people for fun, but their victims
can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute
act is perfect.

label: ZKN_Y_510_000
text:
Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from
behind before its victim has a chance to react.

label: ZKN_Y_511_000
text:
It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from
all over. It’s kind enough to share them
with friends.

label: ZKN_Y_512_000
text:
Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail
around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is
very bitter.

label: ZKN_Y_513_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes.
The fire within the tuft on its head can reach
600 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_Y_514_000
text:
When it gets excited, embers rise from its head
and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it
loves sweets.

label: ZKN_Y_515_000
text:
The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of
nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

label: ZKN_Y_516_000
text:
It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs
low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with
its tail.

label: ZKN_Y_517_000
text:
It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it
eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

label: ZKN_Y_518_000
text:
The dream mist coming from its forehead changes
into many different colors depending on the dream
that was eaten.

label: ZKN_Y_519_000
text:
These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed
to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

label: ZKN_Y_520_000
text:
No matter where in the world it goes, it knows
where its nest is, so it never gets separated from
its Trainer.

label: ZKN_Y_521_000
text:
Males have plumage on their heads. They will never
let themselves feel close to anyone other than
their Trainers.

label: ZKN_Y_522_000
text:
Its mane shines when it discharges electricity.
They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes
to communicate.

label: ZKN_Y_523_000
text:
They have lightning-like movements.
When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of
thunder reverberates.

label: ZKN_Y_524_000
text:
They were discovered a hundred years ago in an
earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an
energy core.

label: ZKN_Y_525_000
text:
When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing
the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left
to right.

label: ZKN_Y_526_000
text:
Compressing the energy from its internal core
lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away
a mountain.

label: ZKN_Y_527_000
text:
The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a
Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring
good fortune.

label: ZKN_Y_528_000
text:
Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic
waves emitted by a courting male experiences a
positive mood shift.

label: ZKN_Y_529_000
text:
By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the
ground at a speed of 30 mph.

label: ZKN_Y_530_000
text:
More than 300 feet below the surface, they build
mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to
subway tunnels.

label: ZKN_Y_531_000
text:
It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using
the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they
are feeling.

label: ZKN_Y_532_000
text:
Always carrying squared logs, they help out with
construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

label: ZKN_Y_533_000
text:
This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that
even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge
an inch.

label: ZKN_Y_534_000
text:
Rather than rely on force, they master moves that
utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

label: ZKN_Y_535_000
text:
By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves
imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of
these sounds to talk.

label: ZKN_Y_536_000
text:
It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long,
sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

label: ZKN_Y_537_000
text:
They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps.
They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

label: ZKN_Y_538_000
text:
When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants
to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

label: ZKN_Y_539_000
text:
Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their
punches more destructive. Disturbing their training
angers them.

label: ZKN_Y_540_000
text:
Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of
leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

label: ZKN_Y_541_000
text:
It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in
leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves
in forests.

label: ZKN_Y_542_000
text:
It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting
leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings
for Sewaddle.

label: ZKN_Y_543_000
text:
Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze
large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

label: ZKN_Y_544_000
text:
It is usually motionless, but when attacked,
it rotates at high speed and then crashes into
its opponent.

label: ZKN_Y_545_000
text:
With quick movements, it chases down its foes,
attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

label: ZKN_Y_546_000
text:
Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group,
they stick to others they find. They end up looking
like a cloud.

label: ZKN_Y_547_000
text:
Like the wind, it can slip through any gap,
no matter how small. It leaves balls of white
fluff behind.

label: ZKN_Y_548_000
text:
Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas
where Petilil live are known to be good for
growing plants.

label: ZKN_Y_549_000
text:
Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its
beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular
with celebrities.

label: ZKN_Y_550_000
text:
Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along,
but sometimes members of one school mingle with
the other’s school.

label: ZKN_Y_551_000
text:
They live buried in the sands of the desert.
The sun-warmed sands prevent their body
temperature from dropping.

label: ZKN_Y_552_000
text:
The special membrane covering its eyes can sense
the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings
even in darkness.

label: ZKN_Y_553_000
text:
They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws
are so powerful, they can crush the body of
an automobile.

label: ZKN_Y_554_000
text:
When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its
body and its internal fire goes down to
1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_Y_555_000
text:
Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit,
making enough power that it can destroy a dump
truck with one punch.

label: ZKN_Y_556_000
text:
Arid regions are their habitat. They move
rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

label: ZKN_Y_557_000
text:
When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes
a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to
crawl into.

label: ZKN_Y_558_000
text:
Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously.
The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of
the battle.

label: ZKN_Y_559_000
text:
Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts
everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.

label: ZKN_Y_560_000
text:
It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking
attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the
group leader.

label: ZKN_Y_561_000
text:
The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly
the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

label: ZKN_Y_562_000
text:
Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face
when it was human. Sometimes they look at it
and cry.

label: ZKN_Y_563_000
text:
Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and
get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

label: ZKN_Y_564_000
text:
Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to
depths beyond half a mile.

label: ZKN_Y_565_000
text:
It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its
developed front appendages and chew it up, shell
or bones and all.

label: ZKN_Y_566_000
text:
Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were
unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one
branch to another.

label: ZKN_Y_567_000
text:
It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky
by running at a speed of 25 mph.

label: ZKN_Y_568_000
text:
Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for
a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

label: ZKN_Y_569_000
text:
